=== Marrëdhëniet e jashtme ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Marrëdhëniet e jashtme të Rusisë|en|Foreign relations of Russia}}}}

[[File:Russian-list-of-unfriendly-countries.svg|thumb|upright=1.3|<span style="background:#3F48CC;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span> Rusia <br /> <span style="background:#AA0000;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span> Vendet në "{{ill|Lista e vendeve dhe territoreve jomiqësore|en|Unfriendly countries and territories list|lt=listën e vendeve dhe territoreve jomiqësore}}" të Rusisë<br />Lista përfshin rivalët gjeopolitikë të Rusisë—shtetet anëtare të [[Bashkimi Evropian|Bashkimit Evropian]] dhe [[Shtetet anëtare të NATO-s|NATO-s]] dhe aleatët e tyre—të cilët kanë vendosur sanksione kundër saj për pushtimin e Ukrainës.]]
Rusia ka rrjetin e gjashtë më të madh diplomatik në botë {{As of|2024|lc=y}}. Ajo mban marrëdhënie diplomatike me 187 [[Shtetet anëtare të Kombeve të Bashkuara|shtete anëtare të Kombeve të Bashkuara]], dy [[Lista e shteteve me njohje të kufizuar|shtete pjesërisht të njohura]],<ref>{{cite web |last=Jones |first=Peter N. |title=Russia's Tightening Abkhazian Stranglehold Threatens Western and Georgian Interests |date=2024-01-15 |work=Harvard International Review |publisher=Harvard International Relations Council |access-date=2025-03-01 |url=https://hir.harvard.edu/washington-must-not-idle-as-russia-tightens-its-abkhazian-stranglehold/ |language=en}}</ref> dhe dy [[Shtetet anëtare të Kombeve të Bashkuara|shtete vëzhguese të Kombeve të Bashkuara]], së bashku me 143 ambasada.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://globaldiplomacyindex.lowyinstitute.org/ |title=Lowy Institute Global Diplomacy Index 2024 |publisher=Lowy Institute |access-date=2025-03-01 |archive-date=2020-08-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200826084025/https://globaldiplomacyindex.lowyinstitute.org/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Si pasardhëse ligjore e Bashkimit Sovjetik,{{sfn|Curtis|1998|pp=429–486|loc=Chapter 8. Foreign Relations}} Rusia mban vendin e saj si [[Anëtarët e përhershëm të Këshillit të Sigurimit të Kombeve të Bashkuara|anëtare e përhershme e Këshillit të Sigurimit të Kombeve të Bashkuara]].<ref>{{cite journal |last=Kramer |first=Mark |title=The Soviet Legacy in Russian Foreign Policy |journal=Political Science Quarterly |publisher=Academy of Political Science |volume=134 |number=4 |year=2019 |pages=585–609 |doi=10.1002/polq.12988 |jstor=45284691 |language=en}}</ref> Ajo përshkruhet përgjithësisht nga analistët politikë si një [[Fuqi e madhe (politikë)|fuqi e madhe]].<ref name="gambit">{{cite journal |editor1-last=Bunde |editor1-first=Tobias |editor2-last=Eisentraut |editor2-first=Sophie |editor3-last=Schütte |editor3-first=Leonard |last=Jintro |first=Pauly |title=Russia: The Czar's Gambit |journal=Munich Security Report 2025: Multipolarization |publisher=Munich Security Conference |date=February 2025 |pages=79–85 |doi=10.47342/EZUC8623-5 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1=Sweijs |first1=T. |last2=De Spiegeleire |first2=S. |last3=de Jong |first3=S. |last4=Oosterveld |first4=W. |last5=Roos |first5=H. |last6=Bekkers |first6=F. |last7=Usanov |first7=A. |last8=de Rave |first8=R. |last9=Jans |first9=K. |title=Volatility and friction in the age of disintermediation |publisher=The Hague Centre for Strategic Studies |page=43 |year=2017 |isbn=978-94-92102-46-1 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=1EonDwAAQBAJ |quote=We qualify the following states as great powers: China, Europe, India, Japan, Russia and the United States. |language=en}}</ref><ref name="l454">{{cite journal |last=Ellman |first=Michael |title=Russia as a great power: from 1815 to the present day. Russia's status dilemmas post-Ukraine war |journal=Journal of Contemporary European Studies |publisher=Informa UK Limited |volume=32 |issue=1 |date=2023-03-22 |issn=1478-2804 |doi=10.1080/14782804.2023.2193878 |pages=80–95 |language=en |quote=Drezner, as well as others like Dan Depetris, agrees that, on principle, Russia can still be counted among the great powers... == Marrëdhëniet e jashtme ==
Rusia është një shtet anëtar i organizatave [[G20]], [[Organizata për Siguri dhe Bashkëpunim në Evropë|OSBE]], [[BRICS]], WTO dhe [[Bashkëpunimi Ekonomik Azi-Paqësor|APEC]]; dhe anëtarja kryesore e organizatave si [[Bashkësia e Shteteve të Pavarura|BSHP]],<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Fish |first1=M. Steven |last2=Samarin |first2=Melissa |last3=Way |first3=Lucan Ahmad |title=Russia and the CIS in 2016 |year=2017 |jstor=26367728 |publisher=University of California Press |volume=57 |number=1 |journal=Asian Survey |pages=93–102 |doi=10.1525/as.2017.57.1.93 |language=en}}</ref> [[Bashkimi Ekonomik Evraziatik|BEEU]],<ref>{{cite journal |last=Sadri |first=Houman A. |title=Eurasian Economic Union (Eeu): a good idea or a Russian takeover? |jstor=43580687 |pages=553–561 |volume=81 |number=4 |year=2014 |journal=Rivista di studi politici internazionali |publisher=Maria Grazia Melchionni |language=en}}</ref> CSTO,<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.economist.com/the-economist-explains/2022/01/06/what-is-the-collective-security-treaty-organisation |title=What is the Collective Security Treaty Organisation? |newspaper=[[The Economist]] |date=2022-01-06 |access-date=2022-01-26 |archive-date=2022-04-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220412224018/https://www.economist.com/the-economist-explains/2022/01/06/what-is-the-collective-security-treaty-organisation |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> dhe {{ill|Organizata e Bashkëpunimit të Shangait|en|Shanghai Cooperation Organisation|lt=SCO}}.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://thediplomat.com/2015/07/russias-pivot-to-asia-and-the-sco/ |last=Tiezzi |first=Shannon |title=Russia's 'Pivot to Asia' and the SCO |work=The Diplomat |date=2015-07-21 |access-date=2022-01-26 |archive-date=2019-07-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190704104451/https://thediplomat.com/2015/07/russias-pivot-to-asia-and-the-sco/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Ajo ishte gjithashtu një shtet anëtar i [[G8]]-s (tani [[G7]]-ja) dhe pjesë e Këshillit të Evropës para përjashtimit të saj nga të dy grupet, përkatësisht në 2014 dhe 2022.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2014/03/24/politics/obama-europe-trip/index.html |title=U.S., other powers kick Russia out of G8 |work=[[CNN]] |date=2014-03-24 |last=Acosta |first=Jim |access-date=2025-03-30 |archive-date=2020-04-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200429124350/https://edition.cnn.com/2014/03/24/politics/obama-europe-trip/index.html |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=2022-03-15 |access-date=2025-03-30 |work=DW News |publisher=[[Deutsche Welle]] |title=Russia leaves the Council of Europe |url=https://www.dw.com/en/russia-formally-departs-council-of-europe/a-61136962 |archive-date=2025-03-30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250330215810/https://www.dw.com/en/russia-formally-departs-council-of-europe/a-61136962 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>

Rusia mban marrëdhënie të ngushta me fqinjin [[Bjellorusia|Bjellorusinë]], e cila është pjesë e [[Bashkimi Rusi Bellorusi|Bashkimit Rusi-Bjellorusi]], një konfederatë supranacionale e dy shteteve.<ref>{{cite journal |title=The Semi-Sovereign State: Belarus and the Russian Neo-Empire |jstor=24907272 |journal=Foreign Policy Analysis |first=Kathleen J. |last=Hancock |volume=2 |number=2 |date=April 2006 |pages=117–136 |publisher=[[Oxford University Press]] |doi=10.1111/j.1743-8594.2006.00023.x |ssrn=1949519 |language=en}}</ref> [[Serbia]] ka qenë [[Marrëdhëniet mes Rusisë dhe Serbisë|një aleate historikisht e ngushtë]] e Rusisë, pasi të dy vendet ndajnë një afinitet të fortë të ndërsjellë kulturor, etnik dhe fetar.<ref>{{cite journal |year=1994 |jstor=40202977 |title=Russia and the Balkans: Pan-Slavism, Partnership and Power |journal=International Journal |first=Lenard J. |last=Cohen |volume=49 |number=4 |pages=814–845 |publisher=SAGE Publishing |doi=10.2307/40202977 |language=en}}</ref> Që nga shekulli 21, marrëdhëniet mes Rusisë dhe Kinës janë [[Marrëdhëniet mes Kinës dhe Rusisë|forcuar ndjeshëm dypalësisht dhe ekonomikisht]] për shkak të interesave politikë të përbashkët.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Bolt |first=Paul J. |title=Sino-Russian Relations in a Changing World Order |year=2014 |volume=8 |number=4 |jstor=26270816 |pages=47–69 |publisher=Air University Press |journal=Strategic Studies Quarterly |language=en}}</ref> [[India]] është klienti më i madh i pajisjeve ushtarake ruse, dhe të dy vendet ndajnë {{ill|Marrëdhëniet mes Indisë dhe Rusisë|en|India–Russia relations|lt=një marrëdhënie të fortë strategjike dhe diplomatike}} që nga epoka sovjetike.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://foreignpolicy.com/2020/07/08/russia-india-relations/ |title=Why India and Russia Are Going to Stay Friends |work=Foreign Policy |first=Emily |last=Tamkin |date=2020-07-08 |access-date=2021-02-02 |archive-date=2021-01-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210112225311/https://foreignpolicy.com/2020/07/08/russia-india-relations/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Rusia ushtron një ndikim të konsiderueshëm politik në rajonin [[Gjeopolitika|gjeopolitikisht]] të rëndësishëm të {{ill|Kaukazi i Jugut|en|South Caucasus|lt=Kaukazit të Jugut}} dhe në Azinë Qendrore,<ref>{{cite book |last1=Özkan |first1=Arda |last2=Tüysüzoglu |first2=Göktürk |title=Conflict Areas in the Caucasus and Central Asia |date=April 2024 |publisher=Bloomsbury Academic |page=312 |isbn=978-1-7936-5127-3 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=KxNhEQAAQBAJ |language=en |quote=Russia holds considerable military, economic, and political power over the Central Asia and Caucasus.}}</ref>
"Të përshkruara në Rusi si "{{ill|Jashtë afër|en|near abroad|lt=jashtë afër}}",{{Sfn|Curtis|1998|pp=429–486|loc=Chapter 8. Foreign Relations}}<ref name="Kolstø">{{Cite journal |last1=Kolstø |first1=Pål |title=Beyond Russia, becoming local: Trajectories of adaption to the fall of the Soviet Union among ethnic Russians in the former Soviet Republics |journal=Journal of Eurasian Studies |date=July 2011 |volume=2 |issue=2 |pages=153–163 |doi=10.1016/j.euras.2011.03.006 |language=en |quote=This is indeed true, Russia does insist that the country has a right and a duty to pose as the protector of all Russians in the so-called 'near abroad'.}}</ref> ndërsa analistët e politikës së huaj i kanë përshkruar dy rajonet si pjesë e "oborrit të pasmë" të Rusisë.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Nation |first=R Craig. |title=Russia and the Caucasus |journal=Connections |year=2015 |volume=14 |number=2 |pages=1–12 |jstor=26326394 |publisher=Partnership for Peace Consortium of Defense Academies and Security Studies Institutes |doi=10.11610/Connections.14.2.01 |doi-access=free |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Swanström |first=Niklas |title=Central Asia and Russian Relations: Breaking Out of the Russian Orbit? |journal=Brown Journal of World Affairs |volume=19 |number=1 |year=2012 |pages=101–113 |id=ProQuest 1326331335 |jstor=24590931 |language=en |quote=The Central Asian states have been dependent on Russia since they gained independence in 1991, not just in economic and energy terms, but also militarily and politically.}}</ref>

Rusia ndan një {{ill|Marrëdhëniet mes Rusisë dhe Turqisë|en|Russia–Turkey relations|lt=marrëdhënie komplekse strategjike, energjetike dhe të mbrojtjes}} me [[Turqia|Turqinë]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Baev |first=Pavel |work=Russie.Nei.Reports |publisher=Ifri |url=https://www.ifri.org/sites/default/files/atoms/files/baev_turkey_russia_2021.pdf |title=Russia and Turkey: Strategic Partners and |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211027233151/https://www.ifri.org/sites/default/files/atoms/files/baev_turkey_russia_2021.pdf |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Ajo mban {{ill|Marrëdhëniet mes Iranit dhe Rusisë|en|Iran–Russia relations|lt=marrëdhënie miqësore}} me [[Irani|Iranin]], pasi është aleat strategjik dhe ekonomik.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Tarock |first=Adam |title=Iran and Russia in 'Strategic Alliance' |volume=18 |number=2 |date=June 1997 |pages=207–223 |journal=Third World Quarterly |publisher=Taylor & Francis |doi=10.1080/01436599714911 |jstor=3993220 |language=en}}</ref> Rusia ka zhvilluar gjithashtu ndjeshëm {{ill|Marrëdhëniet mes Koresë së Veriut dhe Rusisë|en|North Korea–Russia relations|lt=marrëdhëniet e saj}} me [[Koreja e Veriut|Korenë e Veriut]] pas pushtimit të Ukrainës në vitin 2022, me bashkëpunim të shtuar në fushën e mbrojtjes.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Howell |first=Dr Edward |title=North Korea and Russia's dangerous partnership |journal=Chatham House |location=Westminister, London |date=2024-12-04 |access-date=2025-03-12 |url=https://www.chathamhouse.org/sites/default/files/2024-12/2024-12-04-north-korea-russia-dangerous-partnership-howell.pdf |isbn=978-1-78413-632-1 |doi=10.55317/9781784136321 |language=en}}</ref> Në të njëjtën kohë, [[Marrëdhëniet mes Rusisë dhe Ukrainës|marrëdhëniet e saj]] me [[Ukraina|Ukrainën]] fqinje dhe me botën perëndimore — veçanërisht me {{ill|Marrëdhëniet mes Rusisë dhe Shteteve të Bashkuara|en|Russia–United States relations|lt=Shtetet e Bashkuara}} dhe vendet e {{ill|Marrëdhëniet mes Rusisë dhe Bashkimit Evropian|en|Russia–European Union relations|lt=Bashkimit Evropian}} dhe NATO-s — janë shembur.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/24/ukraine-breaks-diplomatic-ties-with-russia |title=Ukraine cuts diplomatic ties with Russia after invasion |work=Al |archive-date=2022-03-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220305163901/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/24/ukraine-breaks-diplomatic-ties-with-russia |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kanerva |first=Ilkka |title=Russia and the West |jstor=48573515 |number=12 |pages=112–119 |year=2018 |publisher=Center for International Relations and Sustainable Development |journal=Horizons: Journal of International Relations and Sustainable Development |language=en}}</ref>
[[File:2019 Foto de família dos Líderes do G20.jpg|thumb|Putin me homologët e G20 në [[Osaka]], 2019]]
Në shekullin XXI, Rusia ka ndjekur një politikë të jashtme agresive që synon të sigurojë {{ill|Fuqia rajonale|en|regional power|lt=dominim rajonal}} në Evropë dhe të rrisë ndikimin e saj ndërkombëtar, si dhe të rrisë mbështetjen e brendshme për qeverinë. Ajo ka nisur ndërhyrje ushtarake në [[Shtetet pas-sovjetike|shtetet pas-sovjetike]] të [[Gjeorgjia|Gjeorgjisë]] dhe [[Ukraina|Ukrainës]], si dhe {{ill|Ndërhyrja ruse në luftën civile siriane|en|Russian intervention in the Syrian civil war|lt=në Siri}} gjatë [[Lufta Civile në Siri|luftës së saj të zgjatur civile]], në përpjekje për të rritur ndikimin e saj në [[Lindja e Mesme|Lindjen e Mesme]] dhe për të arritur ambiciet e saj si fuqi e madhe.<ref>{{Cite report |last=Cerulli |first=Rossella |title=Russian Influence in the Middle East: Economics, Energy, and Soft Power |jstor=resrep19825 |date=2019-09-01 |pages=1–21 |publisher=American Security Project |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.rusi.org/explore-our-research/publications/commentary/russias-enduring-grip-syria |title=Russia's Enduring Grip on Syria |last=Kassis |first=Kelly |work=Royal United Services Institute (RUSI) |date=2025-11-11 |access-date=2026-01-06 |location=London |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ispionline.it/en/publication/after-assad-russias-role-and-leverage-in-the-middle-east-224080 |title=After Assad: Russia's Role and Leverage in the Middle East |work=Institute for International Political Studies (ISPI) |date=2025-12-08 |access-date=2026-01-06 |location=Milan |language=en}}</ref>

=== Ushtria ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Forcat e Armatosura Ruse|en|Russian Armed Forces}}}}

[[File:Sukhoi Design Bureau, 054, Sukhoi T-50 (Su-57 prototype) (49581303977).jpg|thumb|Sukhoi Su-57, një {{ill|Avioni luftarak i gjeneratës së pestë|en|Fifth-generation fighter|lt=avion luftarak i gjeneratës së pestë}} në shërbim të {{ill|Forcat Ajrore Ruse|en|Russian Air Force|lt=Forcave Ajrore Ruse}}<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rand.org/blog/2020/08/russias-su-57-heavy-fighter-bomber-is-it-really-a-5th.html |title=Russia's Su-57 Heavy Fighter Bomber: Is It Really a Fifth-Generation Aircraft? |work=RAND Corporation |author=Ryan Bauer and Peter A. Wilson |date=2020-08-17 |access-date=2021-06-28 |archive-date=2022-03-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220322102224/https://www.rand.org/blog/2020/08/russias-su-57-heavy-fighter-bomber-is-it-really-a-5th.html |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>]]

Forcat e Armatosura Ruse ndahen në [[Ushtria Ruse|Forcat Tokësore]], [[Forca Detare Ruse|Forcën Detare]] dhe Forcat Aero-hapësinore — dhe krahas tyre ekzistojnë edhe dy degë të pavarura shërbimi: Forcat Strategjike të Raketave dhe Trupat Ajrorë.{{sfn|Curtis|1998|pp=487–552|loc=Kapitulli 9. Forcat e Armatosura}}<ref name="cia">{{cite web |url=https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/countries/russia/ |title=Russia – The World Factbook |work=The World Factbook |publisher=Central Intelligence Agency |access-date=2022-03-04 |archive-date=2021-01-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210109173026/https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/countries/russia/ |url-status=dead |language=en}}</ref> {{As of|2025}}, ushtria ka 1,1 milion personel aktiv në detyrë, e pesta më e madhe në botë, dhe rreth 1,5 milion [[Forca rezervë ushtarake|personel rezervë]].<ref>{{cite book |author=International Institute for Strategic Studies |title=The Military Balance |date=2025 |publisher=Routledge |location=London |isbn=978-1-041-049-678 |page=180 |language=en}}</ref> Është e detyrueshme që të gjithë shtetasit meshkuj të moshës 18–27 vjeç të [[Rekrutimi|rekrutohen]] për një vit shërbimi në Forcat e Armatosura.<ref name="cia"/>

Rusia është ndër pesë shtetet e njohura [[Lista e shteteve me armë bërthamore|me armë bërthamore]], me rezervën më të madhe të armëve bërthamore në botë; mbi gjysmën e armëve bërthamore të botës {{ill|Armët e shkatërrimit në masë të Rusisë|en|Russia and weapons of mass destruction|lt=zotërohen nga Rusia}}.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.armscontrol.org/factsheets/Nuclearweaponswhohaswhat |title=Nuclear Weapons: Who Has What at a Glance |work=Arms Control Association |date=August 2020 |access-date=2021-06-07 |archive-date=2018-01-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180124043430/https://www.armscontrol.org/factsheets/Nuclearweaponswhohaswhat |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Rusia zotëron flotën e dytë më të madhe të [[Nëndetësja me raketa balistike|nëndetëseve me raketa balistike]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://power.lowyinstitute.org/data/military-capability/signature-capabilities/ballistic-missile-submarines/ |work=Asia Power Index |publisher=Lowy Institute |year=2021 |title=Ballistic missile submarines data |access-date=2022-01-25 |archive-date=2022-04-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220408173840/https://power.lowyinstitute.org/data/military-capability/signature-capabilities/ballistic-missile-submarines/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> dhe është një nga vetëm tre shtetet që operojnë [[Bombarduesi strategjik|bombardues strategjikë]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Paul |first1=T. V. |last2=Wirtz |first2=James J. |last3=Fortmann |first3=Michael |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=9jy28vBqscQC&pg=332 |title=Balance of power: theory and practice in the 21st century |publisher=Stanford University Press |date=2004 |page=332 |isbn=978-0-8047-5017-2 |language=en}}</ref> {{As of|2025}}, Rusia ka shpenzimet e treta më të larta ushtarake në botë, duke shpenzuar 190 miliardë dollarë, që korrespondojnë me rreth 7,5% të PBB-së së saj.<ref name="SIPRI-2020">{{Cite web |date=April 2026 |title=Trends in Military Expenditure 2025 |url=https://www.sipri.org/sites/default/files/2026-04/2604_milex_2025.pdf#page=2 |access-date=2026-04-26 |publisher=Stockholm International Peace Research Institute |language=en}}</ref> Ishte gjithashtu eksportuesi i tretë më i madh i armëve në periudhën 2020–2024,<ref>{{Cite journal |first1=Pieter D. |last1=Wezeman |first2=Katarina |last2=Djokic |first3=Mathew |last3=George |first4=Zain |last4=Hussain |first5=Siemon T. |last5=Wezeman |title=Trends in international Arms Transfer 2024 |url=https://www.sipri.org/publications/2025/sipri-fact-sheets/trends-international-arms-transfers-2024 |doi=10.55163/XXSZ9056 |date=March 2025 |website=sipri.org |page=2 |language=en}}</ref> dhe ka një industri të madhe dhe vendase të mbrojtjes, e cila prodhon shumicën e pajisjeve ushtarake të saj.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Cooper |first=Julian |title=Military Production in Russia Before and After the Start of the War With Ukraine |date=2024-08-29 |doi=10.1080/03071847.2024.2392990 |journal=RUSI Journal |publisher=Routledge on behalf of the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI) |volume=169 |number=4 |pages=10–29 |doi-access=free |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.csis.org/analysis/back-stock-state-russias-defense-industry-after-two-years-war |title=Back in Stock? The State of Russia's Defense Industry after Two Years of the War |work=Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) |location=Washington, D.C. |date=2024-04-22 |access-date=2025-03-12 |last1=Snegovaya |first1=Maria |last2=Bergmann |first2=Max |last3=Dolbaia |first3=Tina |last4=Fenton |first4=Nicholas |last5=Bendett |first5=Samuel |archive-date=2025-03-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250310181645/https://www.csis.org/analysis/back-stock-state-russias-defense-industry-after-two-years-war |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Roth |first=Andrew |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/feb/15/rate-of-russian-military-production-worries-european-war-planners |title='A lot higher than we expected': Russian arms production worries Europe's war planners |work=The Guardian |date=2024-02-15 |access-date=2024-03-12 |language=en}}</ref>
=== Ligji, korrupsioni dhe krimi ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Ligji i Rusisë|en|Law of Russia}}, {{ill|Zbatimi i ligjit në Rusi|en|Law enforcement in Russia}}, {{ill|Kriminaliteti në Rusi|en|Crime in Russia}}, {{ill|Korrupsioni në Rusi|en|Corruption in Russia}}}}

Rusia post-sovjetike nën regjimin e [[Vladimir Putin|Vladimir Putinit]] ka qenë e qeverisur nga një formë e {{ill|Kapitalizmi i kronizmit|en|Crony capitalism|lt=kapitalizmit të kronizmit}}.<ref name="crony">{{cite book |last=Åslund |first=Anders |year=2019 |title=Russia's Crony Capitalism: The Path from Market Economy to Kleptocracy |pages=5–7 |publisher=Yale University Press |isbn=978-0-300-24486-1 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last=Ledeneva |first=Alena |title=Cronies, Economic Crime and Capitalism in Putin's Sistema |journal=International Affairs |publisher=Chatham House |volume=88 |number=1 |year=2012 |pages=149–157 |doi=10.1111/j.1468-2346.2012.01062.x |jstor=41428546 |language=en}}</ref> Sistemi i saj politik është përshkruar në mënyra të ndryshme si [[Kleptokracia|kleptokraci]],<ref>{{cite journal |last=Fish |first=M. Steven |title=What Has Russia Become? |jstor=26532689 |journal=Comparative Politics |volume=50 |number=3 |date=April 2018 |pages=327–346 |publisher=City University of New York |location=New York City |doi=10.5129/001041518822704872 |language=en}}</ref> [[Oligarkia|oligarki]],<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Guriev |first1=Sergei |last2=Rachinsky |first2=Andrei |title=The Role of Oligarchs in Russian Capitalism |year=2005 |volume=19 |number=1 |journal=The Journal of Economic Perspectives |pages=131–150 |publisher=American Economic Association |doi=10.1257/0895330053147994 |jstor=4134996 |doi-access=free |language=en}}</ref> dhe [[Plutokracia|plutokraci]].<ref name="crony"/> {{As of|2025}}, ajo është shteti evropian me vlerësimin më të ulët në [[Indeksi i Përceptimit të Korrupsionit|Indeksin vjetor të Përceptimit të Korrupsionit]] të [[Transparency International]], duke u renditur e 157-ta nga 180 shtetet e listuara.<ref>{{cite web |date=2026 |title=Corruptions Perceptions Index 2025 |url=https://www.transparency.org/en/cpi/2025 |access-date=2026-06-10 |publisher=Transparency International |archive-date= |archive-url= |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>
[[File:Alexei Navalny marching in 2017.jpg|thumb|Udhëheqësi i opozitës [[Alexei Navalny]] duke udhëhequr protestuesit në [[Moska|Moskë]] gjatë {{ill|Protestat kundër korrupsionit në Rusi 2017–2018|en|2017–2018 Russian protests|lt=protestave kundër korrupsionit në Rusi të viteve 2017–2018}}]]
Korrupsioni është rritur ndjeshëm pas rënies së [[Bashkimi Sovjetik|Bashkimit Sovjetik]],<ref name="SuharaManabu">{{cite web |author=Suhara, Manabu |title=Corruption in Russia: A Historical Perspective |url=https://src-h.slav.hokudai.ac.jp/sympo/03september/pdf/M_Suhara.pdf |publisher=Slavic-Eurasian Research Center |access-date=2015-12-04 |archive-date=2016-03-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304192618/https://src-h.slav.hokudai.ac.jp/sympo/03september/pdf/M_Suhara.pdf |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> dhe shihet si një problem i rëndësishëm në shoqëri.<ref name="markus">{{cite journal |last=Markus |first=Stanislav |title=Oligarchs and Corruption in Putin's Russia: Of Sand Castles and Geopolitical Volunteering |journal=Georgetown Journal of International Affairs |volume=18 |number=2 |year=2017 |pages=26–32 |doi=10.1353/gia.2017.0017 |jstor=26396016 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=New Reports Highlight Russia's Deep-Seated Culture of Corruption |url=https://www.voanews.com/europe/new-reports-highlight-russias-deep-seated-culture-corruption |publisher=Voice of America |date=2020-01-26 |access-date=2020-03-16 |archive-date=2020-01-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200127020812/https://www.voanews.com/europe/new-reports-highlight-russias-deep-seated-culture-corruption |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Ai prek sektorë të ndryshëm, duke përfshirë ekonominë,<ref name="markus"/> [[Qeveria e Rusisë|qeverinë]],<ref name="SuharaManabu"/> zbatimin e ligjit,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Gerber |first1=Theodore P. |last2=Mendelson |first2=Sarah E. |title=Public Experiences of Police Violence and Corruption in Contemporary Russia: A Case of Predatory Policing? |jstor=29734103 |journal=Law & Society Review |volume=42 |number=1 |publisher=Wiley |date=March 2008 |pages=1–44 |doi=10.1111/j.1540-5893.2008.00333.x |language=en}}</ref> shëndetësinë,<ref>{{cite web |author1=Klara Sabirianova Peter |first2=Tetyana |last2=Zelenska |year=2010 |title=Corruption in Russian Health Care: The Determinants and Incidence of Bribery |url=http://www.iza.org/conference_files/worldb2010/zelenska_t5300.pdf |publisher=Georgia State University |access-date=2015-12-04 |archive-date=2015-12-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151208075733/http://www.iza.org/conference_files/worldb2010/zelenska_t5300.pdf |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/corruption-pervades-russias-health-system/ |title=Corruption Pervades Russia's Health System |publisher=CBS News |date=2007-06-28 |access-date=2021-11-20 |archive-date=2014-03-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140302213758/https://www.cbsnews.com/news/corruption-pervades-russias-health-system/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> dhe [[Arsimi në Rusi|arsimin]].<ref>{{cite web |first1=Elena |last1=Denisova-Schmidt |first2=Elvira |last2=Leontyeva |first3=Yaroslav |last3=Prytula |year=2014 |title=Corruption at Universities is a Common Disease for Russia and Ukraine |url=http://ethics.harvard.edu/blog/corruption-universities-common-disease-russia-and-ukraine |access-date=2015-12-04 |publisher=Harvard University |archive-date=2015-12-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151208155403/http://ethics.harvard.edu/blog/corruption-universities-common-disease-russia-and-ukraine |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>
dhe ushtria.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://rusi.org/explore-our-research/publications/commentary/corruption-russian-armed-forces |title=Corruption in the Russian Armed Forces |last1=Cranny-Evans |first1=Sam |last2=Ivshina |first2=Olga |date=2022-05-12 |publisher=Royal United Services Institute (RUSI) |location=[[Westminster]] |access-date=2022-10-06 |quote=Korrupsioni në forcat e armatosura ruse, dhe në shoqërinë në përgjithësi, ka qenë një e vërtetë e pranuar prej kohësh. |archive-date=2022-10-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221006212135/https://rusi.org/explore-our-research/publications/commentary/corruption-russian-armed-forces/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> [[Ekonomia joformale|Ekonomia në hije]] e Rusisë vlerësohej se përbënte rreth 44% të PBB-së totale në vitin 2018.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Sauka |first1=Arnis |last2=Putniņš |first2=Tālis J. |title=Shadow Economy |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-recruited-convicts-fierce-assault-units-storm-gladiator-/32806371.html |title=Storm Gladiator: How Russia Uses Recruited Convicts To Fight In 'Fierce' Assault Units |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-67175566 |title=Ukraine war: Russia goes back to prisons to feed its war machine |work=[[BBC]] |last=Shevchenko Parimi parësor dhe themelor i ligjit në Rusi është [[Kushtetuta e Rusisë|kushtetuta]]. Statutet, si Kodi Civil Rus dhe Kodi Penal Rus, janë burimet kryesore ligjore të së drejtës ruse.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Partlett |first=William |title=Reclassifying Russian Law: Mechanisms, Outcomes, and Solutions for an Overly Politicized Field |website=Search eLibrary |date=2010-07-07 |ssrn=1197762 |url=https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1197762 |access-date=2023-05-23 |archive-date=2023-05-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230523233257/https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1197762 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last1=Butler |first1=William E. |title=Criminal Code of the Russian Federation |year=1999 |publisher=Springer |language=en}}</ref> Rusia ka popullsinë më të madhe të të burgosurve në Evropë dhe popullsinë e pestë më të madhe të të burgosurve në botë.<ref name="icjpr">{{Cite web |url=https://www.icpr.org.uk/news-events/2024/prison-populations-continue-rise-many-parts-world-115-million-held-prisons |title=Prison populations continue to rise in many parts of the world, with 11.5 million held in prisons worldwide |work=Institute for Crime & Justice Policy Research |publisher=Birkbeck, University of London |date=2024-05-01 |access-date=2025-04-07 |archive-date=2024-11-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241109143338/https://icpr.org.uk/news-events/2024/prison-populations-continue-rise-many-parts-world-115-million-held-prisons |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Norma e burgosjes së saj është ndër më të lartat në Evropë,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Adami |first=Marina |url=https://www.politico.eu/article/europe-prison-population-data-incarceration/ |title=Turkey, Russia lead Europe's incarceration rates |work=Politico |date=2021-04-08 |access-date=2025-04-07 |archive-date=2025-06-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250606181806/https://www.politico.eu/article/europe-prison-population-data-incarceration/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> megjithëse numri ka rënë vazhdimisht, me 59% që nga viti 2000.<ref name="icjpr" /> {{As of|2021}}, norma e vrasjeve me dashje në Rusi ishte 6,8 për 100.000 njerëz.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://genderdata.worldbank.org/en/indicator/vc-ihr-psrc-p5?gender=total |title=Intentional homicides (per 100,000 people) |work=[[Banka Botërore]] |access-date=2025-04-07 |archive-date=2025-04-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250416202920/https://genderdata.worldbank.org/en/indicator/vc-ihr-psrc-p5?gender=total |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Në vitin 2023, Rusia kishte tregun e dytë më të madh në botë të tregtisë së paligjshme të armëve, pas Shteteve të Bashkuara, përshkruhej si një qendër kryesore e trafikimit të qenieve njerëzore dhe renditej e para në Evropë dhe e 19-ta në botë në Indeksin Global të Krimit të Organizuar.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Criminality in Russia |website=The Organized Crime Index |date=2023-05-04 |url=https://ocindex.net/country/russia |access-date=2025-04-16 |archive-date=2025-04-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250424161408/https://ocindex.net/country/russia |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>
===Të drejtat e njeriut===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Të drejtat e njeriut në Rusi|en|Human rights in Russia}}}}

Shkeljet e të drejtave të njeriut në Rusi janë raportuar gjithnjë e më shumë nga grupet kryesore të demokracisë dhe të drejtave të njeriut. Në veçanti, [[Amnesty International]] dhe [[Human Rights Watch]] thonë se Rusia nuk është demokratike dhe u lejon qytetarëve të saj pak të drejta politike dhe liri civile.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.amnesty.org/en/countries/europe-and-central-asia/russian-federation/ |title=Russian Federation |work=Amnesty International |publisher=[[Amnesty International]] |language=en |access-date=2020-03-16 |archive-date=2020-03-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200320043314/https://www.amnesty.org/en/countries/europe-and-central-asia/russian-federation/ |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hrw.org/europe/central-asia/russia |title=Russia |publisher=[[Human Rights Watch]] |language=en |access-date=2021-11-20 |archive-date=2022-04-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413065628/https://www.hrw.org/europe/central-asia/russia |url-status=live}}</ref>

Që nga viti 2004, {{ill|Freedom House|en|Freedom House}} e ka renditur Rusinë si "jo të lirë" në studimin e saj vjetor ''{{ill|Freedom in the World|en|Freedom in the World}}''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2021 |title=Russia: Freedom in the World 2021 |publisher=Freedom House |language=en |access-date=2021-11-20 |archive-date=2022-04-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413204526/https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2021 |url-status=live}}</ref> Që nga viti 2011, {{ill|Economist Intelligence Unit|en|Economist Intelligence Unit}} e ka renditur Rusinë si "regjim autoritar" në Indeksin e Demokracisë, duke e renditur atë të 148-tin nga 167 vende në vitin 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-04-07 |title=Global democracy is in better shape than you think |url=https://www.economist.com/interactive/democracy-index-2025 |access-date=2026-06-10 |website=[[The Economist]] |language=en}}</ref> Për sa i përket lirisë së medias, Rusia u rendit e 172-ta nga 180 vende në {{ill|Indeksi i Lirisë së Shtypit|en|Press Freedom Index}} të {{ill|Raportuesit pa Kufij|en|Reporters Without Borders}} për vitin 2026.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://rsf.org/en/russia |title=Russia |work=Reporters Without Borders |language=en |access-date=2022-06-08 |archive-date=2020-12-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201213163540/https://rsf.org/en/russia |url-status=live}}</ref> Qeveria ruse është kritikuar gjerësisht nga disidentë politikë dhe aktivistë të të drejtave të njeriut për zgjedhje të padrejta,<ref>{{cite web |last=Simmons |first=Ann M. |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/russias-opposition-candidates-struggle-to-make-a-mark-in-election-11631886631 |title=In Russia's Election, Putin's Opponents Are Seeing Double |work=[[The Wall Street Journal]] |date=2021-09-18 |access-date=2021-12-22 |language=en}}</ref> shtypjen e partive politike opozitare dhe protestave,<ref>{{cite news |last=Kramer |first=Andrew E. |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2021/06/10/world/europe/putin-navalny-russian-opposition-crackdown.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20211228/https://www.nytimes.com/2021/06/10/world/europe/putin-navalny-russian-opposition-crackdown.html |archive-date=2021-12-28 |url-access=limited |title=In Shadow of Navalny Case, What's Left of the Russian Opposition? |work=[[The New York Times]] |date=2021-06-10 |access-date=2021-11-24 |language=en}}{{cbignore}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211123224350/http://www.newyorker.com/news/dispatch/the-victims-of-putins-crackdown-on-the-press |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last=Simon |first=Scott |title=Why Do Russian Journalists Keep Falling? |url=https://www.npr.org/2018/04/21/604497554/why-do-russian-journalists-keep-falling |date=2018-04-21 |work=NPR |access-date=2022-10-07 |archive-date=2022-10-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221003104459/https://www.npr.org/2018/04/21/604497554/why-do-russian-journalists-keep-falling |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> si dhe censurimin e medias masive dhe {{ill|Censura e internetit në Rusi|en|Internet censorship in Russia|lt=censurimin e internetit}}.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hrw.org/news/2020/06/18/russia-growing-internet-isolation-control-censorship |title=Russia: Growing Internet Isolation, Control, Censorship |publisher=[[Human Rights Watch]] |date=2020-06-18 |access-date=2021-11-24 |archive-date=2022-04-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220412225449/https://www.hrw.org/news/2020/06/18/russia-growing-internet-isolation-control-censorship |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>
[[File:Protest against the invasion of Ukraine (Yekaterinburg, February 24, 2022).jpg|thumb|Pas {{ill|Pushtimi rus i Ukrainës|en|2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|lt=pushtimit rus të Ukrainës}} në vitin 2022, {{ill|Protestat kundër luftës në Rusi (2022–tani)|en|Anti-war protests in Russia (2022–present)|lt=protestat kundër luftës}} shpërthyen në të gjithë Rusinë. Protestat u përballën me represion të gjerë, duke çuar në arrestimin e rreth 15.000 personave.<ref>{{cite web |last=Shevchenko |first=Vitaliy |date=2022-03-15 |title=Ukraine war: Protester exposes cracks in Kremlin's war message |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60749064 |access-date=2022-04-03 |publisher=BBC |language=en}}</ref>]]

Muslimanët, veçanërisht [[Selefizmi|selefistët]], janë përballur me persekutim në Rusi.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Herszenhorn |first=David M. |date=2015-07-01 |title=Russia Sees a Threat in Its Converts to Islam |language=en |work=[[The New York Times]] |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2015/07/02/world/russia-sees-a-threat-in-its-converts-to-islam.html |url-status=live |issn=0362-4331 |url-access=limited |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150703140541/http://www.nytimes.com/2015/07/02/world/russia-sees-a-threat-in-its-converts-to-islam.html |archive-date=2015-07-03}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-04-21 |title=U.S. Report Says Russia Among 'Worst Violators' Of Religious Freedom |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-worst-violators-religious-freedom-report-iran-turkmenistan/31215737.html |website=[[Radio Evropa e Lirë]] |language=en |access-date=2022-11-17 |archive-date=2022-03-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220307100648/https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-worst-violators-religious-freedom-report-iran-turkmenistan/31215737.html |url-status=live}}</ref> Për të shtypur [[Kryengritja në Kaukazin e Veriut|kryengritjen në Kaukazin e Veriut]], autoritetet ruse janë akuzuar për vrasje pa dallim,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Clancy Chassay |date=2009-09-19 |title=Russian killings and kidnaps extend dirty war in Ingushetia |url=http://www.theguardian.com/world/2009/sep/20/ingushetia-dirty-war-russia |url-status=live |website=[[The Guardian]] |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221117091935/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2009/sep/20/ingushetia-dirty-war-russia |archive-date=2022-11-17}}</ref> arrestime, zhdukje me forcë dhe torturim të civilëve.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sokolov |first=Denis |date=2016-08-20 |title=Putin's Savage War Against Russia's 'New Muslims' |url=https://www.newsweek.com/putin-savage-war-against-russia-new-muslims-490783 |access-date=2022-11-17 |website=Newsweek |language=en |archive-date=2022-11-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221117091931/https://www.newsweek.com/putin-savage-war-against-russia-new-muslims-490783 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Citation |title=🇷🇺Ingushetia: A second Chechnya? l People and Power |date=2010-10-13 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0_kHz8bhMFc&t=504s |publisher=Al Jazeera |language=en |access-date=2022-11-17 |archive-date=2022-11-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221117091931/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0_kHz8bhMFc&t=504s |url-status=live}}</ref> Në [[Dagestani|Dagestan]], disa selefistë, krahas përballjes me ngacmime nga qeveria për shkak të pamjes së tyre, kanë pasur shtëpitë e tyre të hedhura në erë gjatë operacioneve kundër kryengritjes.<ref>{{Citation |title=Russia's Invisible War: Crackdown on Salafi Muslims in Dagestan |date=2015-06-17 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rfjsgSiBkZQ |publisher=Human Rights Watch |language=en |access-date=2022-11-17}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Associated Press |date=2015-11-25 |title=Russian Crackdown on Muslims Fuels Exodus to IS |url=https://www.voanews.com/a/russian-crackdown-on-muslims-fuels-exodus-to-islamic-state/3073139.html |website=[[Voice of America]] |language=en |access-date=2022-11-17 |archive-date=2022-11-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221117091931/https://www.voanews.com/a/russian-crackdown-on-muslims-fuels-exodus-to-islamic-state/3073139.html |url-status=live}}</ref> Sipas raporteve, [[Çeçenët|çeçenët]] dhe ingushët në burgjet ruse pësojnë më shumë abuzime sesa grupet e tjera etnike.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Mairbek Vatchagaev |date=2015-04-09 |title=Abuse of Chechens and Ingush in Russian Prisons Creates Legions of Enemies |url=https://jamestown.org/program/abuse-of-chechens-and-ingush-in-russian-prisons-creates-legions-of-enemies-2/ |website=Jamestown Foundation |language=en}}</ref> Gjatë pushtimit të Ukrainës në 2022, Rusia ka ngritur {{ill|Kampet ruse të filtrimit për ukrainasit|en|Russian filtration camps for Ukrainians|lt=kampe filtrimi}} ku shumë ukrainas u nënshtrohen abuzimeve dhe dërgohen me forcë në Rusi; kampet janë krahasuar me ato të përdorura në Luftërat e Çeçenisë.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marquise Francis |date=2022-04-07 |title=What are Russian 'filtration camps'? |url=https://news.yahoo.com/what-are-russian-filtration-camps-194643731.html |website=Yahoo! News |language=en |access-date=2022-11-17 |archive-date=2022-11-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221117091931/https://news.yahoo.com/what-are-russian-filtration-camps-194643731.html |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last1=Katie Bo Lillis |last2=Kylie Atwood |last3=Natasha Bertrand |title=Russia is depopulating parts of eastern Ukraine, forcibly removing thousands into remote parts of Russia |url=https://www.cnn.com/2022/05/26/politics/ukraine-filtration-camps-forcibly-remove-russia/index.html |access-date=2022-11-17 |website=[[CNN]] |date=2022-05-26 |language=en |archive-date=2022-11-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221117091931/https://www.cnn.com/2022/05/26/politics/ukraine-filtration-camps-forcibly-remove-russia/index.html |url-status=live}}</ref> Represioni politik u rrit gjithashtu pas fillimit të pushtimit, me {{ill|Ligjet ruse të censurës së luftës 2022|en|Russian 2022 war censorship laws|lt=ligje të miratuara}} që parashikojnë dënime për "diskreditimin" e forcave të armatosura.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Weir |first1=Fred |title=In Russia, critiquing the Ukraine war could land you in prison |url=https://www.csmonitor.com/World/Europe/2022/1205/In-Russia-critiquing-the-Ukraine-war-could-land-you-in-prison |work=CSMonitor.com |date=2022-12-05 |archive-date=2023-06-02 |access-date=2023-12-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230602022102/https://www.csmonitor.com/World/Europe/2022/1205/In-Russia-critiquing-the-Ukraine-war-could-land-you-in-prison |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>

Rusia ka vendosur disa kufizime mbi {{ill|Të drejtat e personave LGBT në Rusi|en|LGBTQ rights in Russia|lt=të drejtat e personave LGBT}}. Në 2013, {{ill|Ligji rus anti-LGBT|en|Russian anti-LGBTQ law|lt=një ligj anti-LGBT}} që ndalon "propagandën homoseksuale" u miratua unanimisht nga [[Duma e Shtetit]] dhe [[Këshilli i Federatës]], dhe më pas u nënshkrua në ligj nga [[Vladimir Putin|Vladimir Putini]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/jun/11/russia-law-banning-gay-propaganda |title=Russia passes law banning gay 'propaganda' |work=[[The Guardian]] |date=2013-06-11 |last=Elder |first=Miriam |access-date=2025-04-17 |archive-date=2020-04-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200410184402/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/jun/11/russia-law-banning-gay-propaganda |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Në 2020, parlamenti rus legalizoi një ndalim kushtetues të martesës së personave të të njëjtit seks,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nbcnews.com/feature/nbc-out/russian-voters-back-referendum-banning-same-sex-marriage-n1232802 |title=Russian voters back referendum banning same-sex marriage |work=NBC News |access-date=2025-04-17 |date=2020-07-03 |last=Venkatraman |first=Sakshi |archive-date=2020-07-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200709040916/https://www.nbcnews.com/feature/nbc-out/russian-voters-back-referendum-banning-same-sex-marriage-n1232802 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> dhe në 2021 Ministria e Drejtësisë caktoi grupin e të drejtave LGBT {{ill|Rrjeti LGBT rus|en|Russian LGBT Network}} si "agjent i huaj".<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2021/11/russia-frontline-group-lgbt-network-and-human-rights-lawyers-branded-foreign-agents/ |title=Russia: Frontline group LGBT-Network and human rights lawyers branded "foreign agents" |date=2021-11-09 |work=[[Amnesty International]] |access-date=2025-04-17 |archive-date=2025-06-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250606181757/https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2021/11/russia-frontline-group-lgbt-network-and-human-rights-lawyers-branded-foreign-agents/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Në 2022, u bënë amendamente të mëtejshme në ligjin anti-LGBT të 2013.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/05/europe/russia-lgbtq-propaganda-law-signed-by-putin-intl/index.html |title=Putin signs expanded anti-LGBTQ laws in Russia, in latest crackdown on rights |work=[[CNN]] |date=2022-12-05 |access-date=2025-04-17 |last1=Kottasová |first1=Ivana |last2=Chernova |first2=Anna |archive-date=2025-03-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250318172700/https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/05/europe/russia-lgbtq-propaganda-law-signed-by-putin-intl/index.html |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Në 2023, parlamenti rus miratoi një projektligj që ndalon operacionin e ndryshimit të gjinisë për personat [[Transgjinor|transgjinorë]], dhe {{ill|Gjykata e Lartë e Rusisë|en|Supreme Court of Russia}} e shpalli lëvizjen ndërkombëtare LGBT "ekstremiste", duke e vënë jashtë ligjit në vend.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66200194 |title=Russian parliament bans gender reassignment surgery for trans people |last=Murphy |first=Matt |date=2023-07-14 |access-date=2025-04-17 |work=[[BBC]] |archive-date=2025-04-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250416100656/https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66200194 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/11/30/russia-supreme-court-bans-lgbt-movement-extremist |title=Russia: Supreme Court Bans LGBT Movement as "Extremist" |work=[[Human Rights Watch]] |date=2023-11-30 |access-date=2025-04-17 |archive-date=2025-04-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250423210144/https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/11/30/russia-supreme-court-bans-lgbt-movement-extremist |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Në 2024, Gjykata e Lartë nxori dënimet e para sipas vendimit të fundit.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/02/15/russia-first-convictions-under-lgbt-extremist-ruling |title=Russia: First Convictions Under LGBT 'Extremist' Ruling |date=2024-02-15 |access-date=2025-04-17 |work=[[Human Rights Watch]] |archive-date=2025-05-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250513103618/https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/02/15/russia-first-convictions-under-lgbt-extremist-ruling |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>
== Ekonomia ==
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Ekonomia e Rusisë|en|Economy of Russia}}}}
{{Hatnote|Shih më tepër: {{ill|Historia ekonomike e Rusisë|en|Economic history of the Russian Federation}} dhe {{ill|Tatimet në Rusi|en|Taxation in Russia}}}}

Rusia ka një {{ill|ekonomi të përzier|en|Mixed economy}}, me të ardhura të larta,<ref>{{Cite web |title=World Bank Country and Lending Groups – World Bank Data Help Desk |url=https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/906519-world-bank-country-and-lending-groups |access-date=2024-07-01 |website=datahelpdesk.worldbank.org |archive-date=2019-10-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191028223324/https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/906519-world-bank-country-and-lending-groups |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> të industrializuar,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.oxfordreference.com/display/10.1093/oi/authority.20110803100002206 |title=Industrial countries |work=Oxford Reference |publisher=Oxford University Press |access-date=2024-08-03 |quote="...and the countries of the former Soviet Union and Central and Eastern Europe, of which several, including Russia and the Czech Republic, are heavily industrialized." |archive-date=2024-08-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240803212051/https://www.oxfordreference.com/display/10.1093/oi/authority.20110803100002206 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> [[Ekonomia e tregut|të orientuar drejt tregut]], pas një {{ill|Terapia e shokut|en|Shock therapy (economics)|lt=tranzicioni të trazuar}} nga {{ill|Ekonomia e planifikuar|en|Planned economy|lt=modeli i planifikuar sovjetik}} gjatë viteve 1990.{{sfn|Curtis|1998|pp=295–382|loc=The Economy}}<ref>{{cite journal |last=Rutland |first=Peter |title=Neoliberalism and the Russian Transition |journal=Review of International Political Economy |volume=20 |number=2 |publisher=Taylor & Francis |year=2013 |pages=332–362 |doi=10.1080/09692290.2012.727844 |jstor=42003296 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last=Robinson |first=Neil |title=August 1998 and the Development of Russia's Post-Communist Political Economy |journal=Review of International Political Economy |volume=16 |number=3 |publisher=Taylor & Francis |year=2009 |pages=433–455 |doi=10.1080/09692290802418161 |jstor=27756169 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last=Charap |first=Samuel |title=No Obituaries Yet for Capitalism in Russia |journal=Current History |volume=108 |number=720 |publisher=University of California Press |year=2009 |pages=333–338 |doi=10.1525/curh.2009.108.720.333 |jstor=45319724 |language=en}}</ref> Sipas [[Fondi Monetar Ndërkombëtar|Fondit Monetar Ndërkombëtar]], ajo ka [[Lista e vendeve sipas PBB|ekonominë e nëntë më të madhe]] sipas PBB-së nominale dhe ekonominë e katërt më të madhe sipas PBB-së ([[Barazia e Fuqisë Blerëse|PPP]]).<ref name="IMFWEO.RU"/> {{As of|2023}}, sektori i shërbimeve përbën rreth 57% të PBB-së totale, i ndjekur nga sektori industrial (30%), ndërsa sektori bujqësor është më i vogli, me 3% të PBB-së totale.<ref name="cia"/> Ajo ka një fuqi punëtore prej rreth 72 milionë, që është e nënta më e madhe në botë.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SL.TLF.TOTL.IN?locations=RU |title=Labor force, total - Russian Federation |work=World Bank |access-date=2025-03-12 |archive-date=2023-03-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230328001737/https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SL.TLF.TOTL.IN?locations=RU |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Partneri më i madh tregtar i Rusisë është [[Kina]].<ref name="oec">{{cite web |url=https://oec.world/en/profile/country/rus |title=Russia (RUS) Exports, Imports, and Trade Partners |work=The Observatory of Economic Complexity |access-date=2025-04-17 |archive-date=2025-04-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250413093848/https://oec.world/en/profile/country/rus |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>
[[File:Moscow-City 2025.jpg|thumb|{{ill|Qendra Ndërkombëtare e Biznesit të Moskës|en|Moscow International Business Center}}]]
Zhvillimi njerëzor i Rusisë [[Lista e shteteve sipas Indeksit të Zhvillimit Njerëzor|renditet]] si "shumë i lartë" në [[Indeksi i zhvillimit njerëzor|Indeksin vjetor të Zhvillimit Njerëzor]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/specific-country-data#/countries/RUS |title=Russian Federation |work=United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) |access-date=2024-08-05 |quote=Russian Federation's HDI value for 2022 is 0.821— which put the country in the Very High human development category—positioning it at 56 out of 193 countries and territories. |archive-date=2022-08-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220812054834/https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/specific-country-data#/countries/RUS |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Rreth 70% e PBB-së totale të Rusisë nxitet nga konsumi përfundimtar,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/NE.CON.TOTL.ZS?most_recent_value_desc=true&locations=RU |title=Final consumption expenditure (% of GDP) – Russia |work=World Bank |access-date=2024-08-05 |archive-date=2024-08-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240805103324/https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/NE.CON.TOTL.ZS?most_recent_value_desc=true&locations=RU |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> dhe vendi ka tregun e konsumit të dymbëdhjetë më të madh në botë.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/NE.CON.PRVT.CD?most_recent_value_desc=true&year_high_desc=true |title=Household final consumption expenditure (current US$) |publisher=World Bank |access-date=2024-08-05 |archive-date=2020-11-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201111211439/https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/NE.CON.PRVT.CD?most_recent_value_desc=true |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>
== Ekonomia ==
Sipas ''[[Forbes]]'', Rusia ka numrin e pestë më të lartë të miliarderëve në botë.<ref>{{cite web |title=Forbes Billionaires 2021 |url=https://www.forbes.com/billionaires/ |website=Forbes |access-date=2021-04-13 |archive-date=2019-01-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190104180124/https://www.forbes.com/billionaires/list/3/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Megjithatë, pabarazia e të ardhurave të saj mbetet e lartë në krahasim me vendet e tjera të zhvilluara.<ref>{{cite journal |url=https://www.europarl.europa.eu/RegData/etudes/ATAG/2018/620225/EPRS_ATA(2018)620225_EN.pdf |title=Socioeconomic inequality in Russia |journal=European Parliamentary Research Service |publisher=[[Kuvendi Evropian]] |date=April 2018 |last=Russell |first=Martin |access-date=2022-01-25 |archive-date=2022-02-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220217150505/https://www.europarl.europa.eu/RegData/etudes/ATAG/2018/620225/EPRS_ATA(2018)620225_EN.pdf |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Ndryshimi i burimeve natyrore midis subjekteve federale ka çuar gjithashtu në pabarazi ekonomike rajonale.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Remington |first=Thomas F. |title=Why is interregional inequality in Russia and China not falling? |volume=48 |number=1 |date=March 2015 |publisher=University of California Press |journal=Communist and Post-Communist Studies |pages=1–13 |doi=10.1016/j.postcomstud.2015.01.005 |jstor=48610321 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Kholodilin |first1=Konstantin A. |last2=Oshchepkov |first2=Aleksey |last3=Siliverstovs |first3=Boriss |title=The Russian Regional Convergence Process: Where Is It Leading? |year=2012 |volume=50 |number=3 |pages=5–26 |journal=Eastern European Economics |publisher=Taylor & Francis |doi=10.2753/EEE0012-8775500301 |jstor=41719700 |language=en}}</ref> Nivelet e larta të [[Korrupsioni në Rusi|korrupsionit]],<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Schulze |first1=Günther G. |last2=Sjahrir |first2=Bambang Suharnoko |last3=Zakharov |first3=Nikita |title=Corruption in Russia |journal=The Journal of Law and Economics |publisher=The University of Chicago Press |volume=59 |number=1 |date=February 2016 |pages=135–171 |doi=10.1086/684844 |jstor=26456942 |language=en}}</ref> të ardhurat në rënie nga eksporti i naftës,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.csis.org/analysis/russia-oil-surcharge-anticipating-benefits-and-challenges |title=The Russia Oil Surcharge: Anticipating the Benefits and Challenges |last=Seigle |first=Clayton |date=2025-08-26 |access-date=2025-09-04 |work=Center for Strategic and International Studies |location=Washington, D.C. |archive-date=2025-08-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250827115304/https://www.csis.org/analysis/russia-oil-surcharge-anticipating-benefits-and-challenges |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> fuqia punëtore në tkurrje,<ref>{{cite journal |last=Kapeliushnikov |first=Rostislav I. |title=The Russian labor market: Long-term trends and short-term fluctuations |publisher=Voprosy Ekonomiki |journal=Russian Journal kapitalit njerëzor|ikja e kapitalit njerëzor]],<ref>{{cite web |last=Sor |first=Jennifer |url=https://www.businessinsider.com/russia-economy-outlook-ukraine-war-worker-shortage-population-brain-drain-2024-8 |title=Why Russia's brain drain is the biggest problem facing its economy |language=en}}</ref> dhe plakja e popullsisë dhe rënia e saj numërore mbeten gjithashtu pengesa kryesore për rritjen ekonomike në të ardhmen.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Mikhailova |first1=Olga Pas {{ill|Pushtimi rus i Ukrainës|en|2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|lt=Pushtimit rus të Ukrainës}}, vendi është përballur me {{ill|Sanksionet ndërkombëtare gjatë pushtimit rus të Ukrainës|en|International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine|lt=sanksione të gjera}} dhe veprime të tjera financiare negative nga [[Bota perëndimore]] dhe aleatët e saj, të cilat synojnë izolimin e ekonomisë ruse nga sistemi financiar perëndimor.<ref name="Walsh-2022"/> Megjithatë, Rusia e ka përfunduar tranzicionin e saj drejt një [[Ekonomia e luftës|ekonomi lufte]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy2404 |title=As Russia Completes Transition to a Full War Economy, Treasury Takes Sweeping Aim at Foundational Financial Infrastructure and Access to Third Country Support |date=2024-06-12 |access-date=2025-03-06 |work=[[Departamenti i Thesarit i Shteteve të Bashkuara]] |archive-date=2024-06-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240613110004/https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy2404 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> dhe ka treguar gjerësisht rezistencë ndaj masave të tilla, duke ruajtur stabilitetin dhe rritjen ekonomike—të nxitura kryesisht nga [[Lista e vendeve sipas shpenzimeve ushtarake|shpenzime të larta ushtarake]],<ref>{{cite web |last1=Luzin |first1=Pavel |last2=Prokopenko |first2=Alexandra |url=https://carnegieendowment.org/russia-eurasia/politika/2023/09/russias-2024-budget-shows-its-planning-for-a-long-war-in-ukraine?lang=en |title=Russia's 2024 Budget Shows It's Planning for a Long War in Ukraine |publisher=[[Carnegie Endowment for International Peace]] |location=Washington, D.C. |date=2023-10-11 |access-date=2024-08-03 |quote=The war against Ukraine and the West is not only the Kremlin's biggest priority; it is now also the main driver of Russia's economic growth. |archive-date=2023-10-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231012082647/https://carnegieendowment.org/politika/90753 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> rritje e konsumit familjar dhe e pagave,<ref>{{cite web |last1=Kurbangaleeva |first1=Ekaterina |url=https://carnegieendowment.org/russia-eurasia/politika/2024/05/russia-war-income?lang=en |title=Russia's Soaring Wartime Salaries Are Bolstering Working-Class Support for Putin |publisher=[[Carnegie Endowment for International Peace]] |location=Washington, D.C. |date=2024-05-28 |access-date=2024-08-04 |archive-date=2024-10-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241008010534/https://carnegieendowment.org/russia-eurasia/politika/2024/05/russia-war-income?lang=en |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> [[Papunësia|papunësi]] të ulët<ref name="reutersunem">{{cite web |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/soaring-wages-record-low-unemployment-underscore-russias-labour-squeeze-2024-06-05/ |title=Soaring wages, record-low unemployment underscore Russia's labour squeeze |last1=Marrow |first1=Alexander |last2=Korsunskaya |first2=Darya |work=Reuters |date=2024-06-05 |access-date=2024-08-04 |quote=Russia's unemployment rate dropped to a record-low 2.6% in April and real wages soared in March, data published by the federal statistics service showed on Wednesday, highlighting the extent of Russia's tight labour market. |language=en}}</ref> dhe [[Shpenzimi qeveritar|shpenzime qeveritare]] në rritje.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4nn7pej9jyo |title=Russia's economy is growing, but can it last? |last=Rosenberg |first=Steve |work=BBC News |publisher=[[BBC]] |date=2024-06-06 |access-date=2024-08-03 |archive-date=2024-08-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240803220205/https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c4nn7pej9jyo |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Sidoqoftë, [[Inflacioni|inflacioni]] ka mbetur relativisht i lartë,<ref>{{Cite news |title=Russian inflation is too high. Does that matter? |url=https://www.economist.com/finance-and-economics/2025/02/13/russian-inflation-is-too-high-does-that-matter |access-date=2025-02-24 |newspaper=[[The Economist]] |issn=0013-0613 |archive-date=2025-02-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250226130959/https://www.economist.com/finance-and-economics/2025/02/13/russian-inflation-is-too-high-does-that-matter |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> ndërsa ekspertët parashikojnë që sanksionet do të kenë një efekt negativ afatgjatë në ekonominë ruse.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Gorodnichenko |first1=Yuriy |last2=Korhonen |first2=Likka |last3=Ribakova |first3=Elina |url=https://cepr.org/voxeu/columns/russian-economy-war-footing-new-reality-financed-commodity-exports |title=The Russian economy on a war footing: A new reality financed by commodity exports |publisher=Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR) |location=London |date=2024-05-24 |access-date=2024-08-03 |language=en}}</ref> Për më tepër, sanksionet ndërkombëtare kanë bërë që Rusia të bëhet shumë e varur ekonomikisht dhe teknologjikisht nga Kina.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Russia becomes China's 'junior partner' |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/08/12/china-russia-power-imbalance-putin-xi-junior-partner/ |access-date=2023-04-28 |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]] |language=en |issn=0190-8286 |last=Tharoor |first=Ishaan |date=2022-08-12}}</ref><ref name=":152">{{Cite news |date=2026-05-20 |title=How China quietly helps Russia in Ukraine |url=https://www.economist.com/china/2026/05/20/how-china-quietly-helps-russia-in-ukraine |url-access=subscription |access-date=2026-05-23 |work=[[The Economist]] |issn=0013-0613 |language=en}}</ref>
=== Transporti dhe energjia ===
{{Hatnote|Artikulli kryesor: {{ill|Transporti në Rusi|en|Transport in Russia}}, {{ill|Energjia në Rusi|en|Energy in Russia}}}}

{{ill|Transporti hekurudhor në Rusi|en|Rail transport in Russia}} kontrollohet kryesisht nga kompania shtetërore {{ill|Hekurudhat Ruse|en|Russian Railways}}. Gjatësia e përgjithshme e linjave hekurudhore me përdorim të përbashkët është e treta më e gjatë në botë, duke tejkaluar {{convert|87000|km|mi|-2|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/field/railways/country-comparison |title=Railways – The World Factbook |work=The World Factbook |publisher=[[Agjencia Qendrore e Inteligjencës (ShBA)]] |access-date=2021-06-15 |archive-date=2018-11-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181124012056/https://www.cia.gov/library/publications/the-world-factbook/rankorder/2121rank.html |language=en}}</ref> {{As of|2019}}, Rusia ka rrjetin rrugor të pestë më të madh në botë, me mbi 1,5 milion&nbsp;km rrugë.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://government.ru/info/22865/ |title=О развитии дорожной инфраструктуры (Mbi zhvillimin e infrastrukturës rrugore) |work=[[Qeveria e Rusisë]] |date=2016-04-29 |access-date=2021-01-14 |archive-date=2019-09-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190901004438/http://government.ru/info/22865/ |url-status=live |language=ru}}</ref> Megjithatë, dendësia e rrugëve të saj është ndër më të ulëtat në botë, pjesërisht për shkak të sipërfaqes së saj të madhe tokësore.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://worldroadstatistics.org/europe-central-asia-continue-to-report-the-worlds-highest-road-network-density-followed-by-east-asia-and-pacific/ |title=Europe continues to report the world's highest Road Network Density, followed by East Asia and Pacific. |work=International Road Federation |date=2020-12-16 |access-date=2021-05-19 |archive-date=2022-03-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220319083620/https://worldroadstatistics.org/europe-central-asia-continue-to-report-the-worlds-highest-road-network-density-followed-by-east-asia-and-pacific/ |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref> Rrugët ujore të brendshme të Rusisë janë më të gjata në botë, me gjithsej {{convert|102000|km|0|abbr=on}}.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/field/waterways/country-comparison |title=Waterways – The World Factbook |work=The World Factbook |publisher=[[Agjencia Qendrore e Inteligjencës (ShBA)]] |access-date=2021-06-15 |archive-date=2022-04-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220412005407/https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/field/waterways/country-comparison |language=en}}</ref> Ajo ka mbi 900 aeroporte, duke u renditur në vendin e shtatë në botë, prej të cilëve më i ngarkuari është {{ill|Aeroporti Ndërkombëtar i Sheremetyevos|en|Sheremetyevo International Airport}} në Moskë. Portet më të mëdha përfshijnë Portin e Novorossijskut, Portin e Madh të Shën Petersburgut dhe Portin e Vladivostokut.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Korovyakovsky |first1=Eugene |last2=Panova |first2=Yulia |title=Dynamics of Russian dry ports |journal=Research in Transportation Economics |volume=33 |number=1 |year=2011 |publisher=Elsevier |doi=10.1016/j.retrec.2011.08.008 |pages=25–34 |language=en}}</ref>

Here's what it was like spending 50 hours on the longest train line in the world. |work=Business Insider |first=Katie |last=Warren |date=2020-01-03 |access-date=2021-06-10 |archive-date=2022-03-31 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220331092048/https://www.businessinsider.com/trans-siberian-railway-russia-what-its-like-photos-2019-7 |url-status=live |language=en}}</ref>
